title: FedSPM: Routing-Enabled Federated Learning under Dual Heterogeneity via Semiparametric Mixture
abstract: arXiv:2607.04085v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Routing-prediction federated learning has emerged as a new paradigm that reframes inter-client heterogeneity as a resource for system-level intelligence: at inference time, the server routes each external query to the best-matched client for prediction. Existing approaches, however, typically treat each client as internally homogeneous, overlooking latent subpopulations within local data. For example, patients with the same diagnosis at one hospital may exhibit morphologically distinct disease subtypes. The coexistence of inter-client and intra-client heterogeneity, which we call dual heterogeneity, can impair both routing and prediction. To address this challenge, we propose FedSPM, a routing-enabled semiparametric mixture framework that represents each client using client-specific latent components. Each component combines a predictive distribution for classification with a feature distribution for routing. To flexibly model

translated_title: FedSPM：基于半参数混合模型的面向双重异构性的路由赋能联邦学习
translated_abstract: 路由-预测联邦学习已成为一种新范式，它将客户端之间的异构性重新定义为系统级智能的资源：在推理时，服务器将每个外部查询路由到最匹配的客户端进行预测。然而，现有方法通常将每个客户端视为内部同质的，忽略了本地数据中潜在的子群体。例如，在一家医院中具有相同诊断的患者可能表现出形态上截然不同的疾病亚型。客户端间异构性与客户端内异构性的共存（我们称之为双重异构性）可能会同时损害路由和预测性能。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了FedSPM，这是一种支持路由的半参数混合框架，使用客户端特定的潜在组件来表示每个客户端。每个组件将用于分类的预测分布与用于路由的特征分布相结合，以灵活地建模
tldr: 提出了FedSPM，一种支持路由的半参数混合联邦学习框架，通过为每个客户端建模客户端特定的潜在组件（每个组件融合分类预测分布与路由特征分布），同时应对客户端间与客户端内的双重异构性挑战。
en_tdlr: FedSPM is a routing-enabled semiparametric mixture federated learning framework that tackles dual heterogeneity (both inter-client and intra-client) by representing each client with client-specific latent components, each combining a predictive distribution for classification with a feature distribution for routing.
